name: Open in editor
description: Open a card's worktree in your editor, or reveal it in the file manager. Pick the editor in the plugin's config; its command-line launcher must be on the server's PATH.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: The launcher the board runs with the worktree path: cursor, code (VS Code), zed, idea (IntelliJ) or subl (Sublime Text).

commands.title: Open in editor
commands.description: Open the card's worktree in the configured editor.

commands.title: Reveal in Finder
commands.description: Show the card's worktree in the file manager (open on macOS, xdg-open elsewhere).

run.exec: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) exec open "$BC_WORKTREE" ;; *) exec xdg-open "$BC_WORKTREE" ;; esac
